content:
In recent hardware price hikes and subscription fee increases in the U.S. and other markets, Apple has now raised iCloud+ prices in several countries. Details below.

Apple's price hike wave continues

Apple raised subscription fees for Apple Music and Apple One in the U.S. and several other countries this week, and increased iPhone prices in Japan by up to 11%.

These price hikes come just days after Apple raised prices on MacBook, iPad, and other products in response to the ongoing memory shortage across the industry.

Now, Apple has also announced a new round of price increases for iCloud+ in multiple markets. Below are the adjusted iCloud+ prices in affected markets effective today:

Egypt (EGP)

  • 50 GB: £49.99 (originally £39.99)
  • 200 GB: £179.99 (originally £149.99)
  • 2 TB: £599.99 (originally £499.99)
  • 6 TB: £1799.99 (originally £1499.99)
  • 12 TB: £3599.99 (originally £2999.99)

Nigeria (NGN)

  • 50 GB: ₦1300 (originally ₦900)
  • 200 GB: ₦4500 (originally ₦2900)
  • 2 TB: ₦14900 (originally ₦9900)
  • 6 TB: ₦39900 (originally ₦26900)
  • 12 TB: ₦66900 (originally ₦44900)

Turkey (TRY)

  • 50 GB: 49.99 TL (originally 39.99 TL)
  • 200 GB: 169.99 TL (originally 129.99 TL)
  • 2 TB: 549.99 TL (originally 399.99 TL)
  • 6 TB: 1699.99 TL (originally 1299.99 TL)
  • 12 TB: 3399.99 TL (originally 2499.99 TL)

Indonesia (IDR)

  • 50 GB: Rp 15000 (price unchanged)
  • 200 GB: Rp 59000 (originally Rp 49000)
  • 2 TB: Rp 199000 (originally Rp 169000)
  • 6 TB: Rp 599000 (originally Rp 499000)
  • 12 TB: Rp 1199000 (originally Rp 999000)

  • 50 GB: ¥180 (originally ¥150)
  • 200 GB: ¥540 (originally ¥450)
  • 2 TB: ¥1800 (originally ¥1500)
  • 6 TB: ¥5500 (originally ¥4500)
  • 12 TB: ¥11000 (originally ¥9000)

  • 50 GB: $1.99 (originally $1.69)
  • 200 GB: $5.99 (originally $4.99)
  • 2 TB: $19.99 (originally $16.99)
  • 6 TB: $59.99 (originally $49.99)
  • 12 TB: $119.99 (originally $99.99)

Philippines (PHP)

  • 50 GB: ₱59 (originally ₱49)
  • 200 GB: ₱199 (originally ₱179)
  • 2 TB: ₱699 (originally ₱599)
  • 6 TB: ₱1990 (originally ₱1790)
  • 12 TB: ₱3990 (originally ₱3590)

Vietnam (VND)

  • 50 GB: ₫25000 (originally ₫19000)
  • 200 GB: ₫89000 (originally ₫69000)
  • 2 TB: ₫299000 (originally ₫249000)
  • 6 TB: ₫899000 (originally ₫749000)
  • 12 TB: ₫1799000 (originally ₫1499000)

Additionally, Apple now lists Laos, Mauritius, and the Republic of Congo as regions where iCloud+ upgrades are "billed in U.S. dollars (USD), with prices potentially slightly higher due to value-added tax (VAT)."

iCloud+ prices in these regions are as follows:

Mauritius (USD)

  • 50 GB: $1.19
  • 200 GB: $3.49
  • 2 TB: $11.99
  • 6 TB: $34.99
  • 12 TB: $69.99

Republic of Congo (USD)

  • 50 GB: $1.19

  • 2 TB: $11.99
  • 6 TB: $34.99
  • 12 TB: $69.99

Laos (USD)
